display_name: LoRa 原生 8192 点双阶段 DURA 结构对照（冻结评估技术恢复）
description: 原 LoRa E104 加载阶段因模块导入冲突失败。保持原冻结恢复器、识别器、物理包、场景和方法规则。只恢复 LoRa 预测及随后独立评分。
authorization: Current user LoRa and WiSig fusion objective and small screening before any complete target release.

data.representation: LoRa continuous complex IQ at 1 MS/s; 8192 points, then original W24 view.
data.contract_ref: Source contract.json of the pinned lora_full_packets_v1 runtime
data.physical_ids_ref: Exact earlier LoRa factor b200_1 160 V packets. Reuse matched frozen decisions and view simulation.
data.label_map_ref: Frozen W24 E104 class mapping; TX labels accessed only by CPU scorer.

data.validation_ref: Reuse registered validates-once source handles and fixed physical panels.
data.leo_config_ref: Only clean and the previously registered source Full practical_low_urban. Targets and other five views are outside this release.

permissions.claim_scope: Source U_s IQ plus generic simulator for fitting. No W24, TX, V or target in fit. No target in this experiment.

sources.role: Frozen E104 default head used after G freeze
Reuse first three paired prediction rows; no prior decisions used by optimizer
复用合法源域拟合后已经固定的双阶段 DURA

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Pinned LoRa source contract and sealed earlier blind panel identity.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Same LoRa contract and no inherited learned parameters. WiSig weights excluded.
checkpoint.selection_rule: 保持 r01 固定第 18,000 步权重，恢复独立两景评分。

execution.launch_owner: Current LoRa performance chat, dual dataset objective
execution.gpu_policy: GPU order [0,7,2,5,6,3]. One worker with >=12288 MiB free, fewer than eight existing compute contexts; no other PID touched.
execution.stop_rule: 复用原权重、配对预测和预登记矩阵。真实 checkpoint 检查失败、非法源访问、同包不一致或技术失败时停止。

rows.method: LoRa two-stage structural DURA reference from scratch
rows.seed_notes: Separate NumPy sampler and Torch simulator; reuse source V IDs drawn previously with 2026113051.
rows.budget_ref: 独立预测评分，复用源 r01 的 18,000 步最终权重。

notes: Test whether the companion proposal or the DURA likelihood update is responsible for the observed loss. The fused control is the prior complete method. Data-only sets the companion residual to zero, while keeping the two constrained CG steps and regularizer. Companion-only turns off the likelihood and uses the exact minimizer of that same prior alone.

All paths retain the same primary waveform, linear complex projection and raw correction norm cap 25%. LoRa primary is the fixed real-gain waveform, WiSig is original R69. This source source V comparison uses no new parameter updates and only clean and registered Full low urban.
Disjoint from earlier 192 screening packets by exact read-only frozen IDs. LoRa also excludes the earlier 300 V. WiSig known archive exposure is retained. Full target remains unchanged and unread.
